notes: «حدثنا أبي (رضي الله عنه)» opens with the father, bare: a relation link (rule 7); the honorific is stripped
The Prophet, «سيد الانبياء محمد», ends the chain and is not a link (rule 12; owner ruling 4); his words are the saying
The Imams named after «عن» are narrators, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); «(عليه السلام)» blessings are not part of the surfaces
